def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    from math import gcd

    n = len(a)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, value in enumerate(a, 1):
        prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1] + value

    hull = []
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 1

    for end in range(k, n + 1):
        new = end - k

        while len(hull) >= 2:
            i, j = hull[-2], hull[-1]
            if (prefix[j] - prefix[i]) * (new - j) < (
                prefix[new] - prefix[j]
            ) * (j - i):
                break
            hull.pop()
        hull.append(new)

        left, right = 0, len(hull) - 1
        while left < right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            i, j = hull[mid], hull[mid + 1]
            if (prefix[end] - prefix[i]) * (end - j) <= (
                prefix[end] - prefix[j]
            ) * (end - i):
                left = mid + 1
            else:
                right = mid

        start = hull[left]
        num = prefix[end] - prefix[start]
        den = end - start
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num, best_den = num, den

    divisor = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // divisor, best_den // divisor]
